summary: Codenames: Pictures swaps the word grid for illustrated image cards, making it more accessible to younger players and non-native speakers while keeping the same clue-giving, team-guessing structure as the original. Clues tend to be more abstract and visual, focused on shapes, colors, and concepts within the images.
praised: great option for families, kids, or mixed-language groups
images allow for more creative, abstract clue associations
same fast, easy-to-teach structure as original Codenames
combines well with original Codenames cards for variety
criticised: some feel picture clues are less satisfying/clever than word clues
images can be ambiguous or overly busy
loses some of the sharp wordplay wit of the original
considered a variant rather than essential on its own

interaction.kind: team communication and clue-guessing under uncertainty

scoring.why: the team that contacts all of its own agents first wins, with no accumulating point total
